{{Quote|Well I can see you're serving drinks&mdash;festooned with beverage dispensers like a vending machine.|C-3PO to R2-D2|<ref name="ROTJRD">[[Return of the Jedi: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''Return of the Jedi'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref>}}
A '''vending machine''' dispensed beverages. During [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|planned execution]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] described [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] as looking like a vending machine while serving drinks aboard the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an item allows the player to summon a vending machine for a short while. It regenerates their health and energy pool.
